# SpeakInCharacter 1.0.0

The first stable release of SpeakInCharacter, a Windows voice companion for
roleplay and everyday chat.

Hold **Caps Lock**, speak naturally, then release. Review the AI-rewritten or
translated line and paste it into chat yourself. SpeakInCharacter preserves
your meaning and never sends messages to games automatically.

## Included in 1.0

- A compact editor in the taskbar and Alt-Tab, with an independent transparent,
  click-through HUD above other windows.
- Persistent system tray: closing the editor keeps the app and recording ready;
  tray click/Open restores it, while Quit/Exit stops the app.
- Adjustable 10–100% HUD opacity and saved positions. Recording raises the HUD's
  opacity halfway toward 100%, then returns to your setting on release.
- Configurable global shortcuts, hold-to-record, short-tap and conservative
  silence guards, and predictable game focus behavior.
- Speech recognition, independent reply language, optional style presets and
  additional character/context instructions.
- Local history with audio playback, editable transcripts/replies, exports,
  deletion controls, retained lifetime statistics and estimated API costs.
- English, Russian, French, Spanish and German interfaces; Windows display
  language selection and light/dark/system appearance.
- Startup feedback and the approved elven microphone app icon, including native
  small/large Windows icons and a separate microphone tray icon.

## Download and update

1. Download `SpeakInCharacter-v1.0.0-Windows-x64-portable.zip` and extract the
   **entire archive** into a new folder.
2. Launch `SpeakInCharacter.exe`. No Node.js or Visual Studio installation is
   required. Configure your personal OpenAI API key in Settings; API usage is
   billed separately from ChatGPT.
3. For game overlays, use borderless/windowed fullscreen.
4. When updating, fully quit the old instance through the tray before starting
   the new one. Existing settings, encrypted API keys, shortcuts, presets,
   positions and history remain in `%APPDATA%\InCharacter`.

The Windows x64 portable build is unsigned. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the
archive checksum. A new extraction folder also avoids stale Explorer icon
caching seen when overwriting earlier preview files.

## Validation

The tagged source is built with locked dependencies and must pass TypeScript,
unit tests/coverage, native keyboard-helper tests, full Windows packaging and
real Electron smoke checks before publication. Smoke checks include editor
layout, native icon dimensions, external focus/desktop transparency, minimized
and tray-hidden recording, and full application exit. The owner has also tested
the editor/HUD behavior and final icon on their Windows/game setup.
